scope: Public teaching data; manual review is separate from automatic contract checks.

utf8-write: Does not confuse newline handling or ensure_ascii with file encoding.
replace-file: Says existing contents are overwritten/replaced, not appended.
Does not invent preservation or backup behavior.
json-result-type: Says json.dumps returns str/text, not bytes.
Does not claim it writes a file or selects file encoding.
backup-schedule: Returns not_in_docs without a backup interval or service-policy claim.
States only that this bounded corpus lacks that policy.
read-newline-312: Answers no for Python3.12, using the 3.12 signature/target.
Does not apply the 3.13 addition to3.12.
read-newline-313: Answers yes for Python3.13 using the 3.13 source.
Treats this source as documented-only; no claim of executing Python3.13.
json-throughput: Returns not_in_docs without invented objects/second or deployment measurements.
Does not turn API semantics into a measured performance claim.
create-parents: Returns not_in_docs because the supplied summaries omit parent-directory behavior.
An outside-corpus Python fact is not a supported answer for this task.
